series.label: DINOv3
series.caveat: Not a like-for-like comparison: DINOv3 started from Meta's released pretrained weights and only continued domain-adaptive self-supervised training, while SimCLR, BYOL and I-JEPA trained their objectives from scratch on the 16k-image pool.

series.label: COCO pretrained
series.caveat: COCO pretraining is supervised on ~118k human-labelled images from a different domain. It is the strongest baseline here, not an SSL result -- the SSL methods saw only the 16k unlabelled in-domain frames.
